stem:
Seema wants daily habits and surroundings that support a healthy body and a healthy mind.

Which choice best supports good health?

options.text: Staying awake late watching videos on her phone.
Eating a balanced meal, sleeping on time, and playing outside with friends.
Eating only the sweets she likes most because they taste good.
Keeping her classroom clean but ignoring broken furniture and unsafe corners.

teacher.key_rationale: Health is supported by balanced food, rest, activity, and safe clean surroundings together—not late screens, sweets alone, or cleanliness that ignores unsafe places.
